impeccable.notes: No scripts/bin: the launcher downloads the detector binary on first use.

ponytail.notes: Skill only. The injection into the studio subagents is done by hooks/subagent.js.

graphify.notes: Changed: disable-model-invocation (only /studio:graphify). On first use it installs the graphifyy Python package.

context7.notes: Only the skill for using the remote MCP server declared in .mcp.json; the ctx7 CLI (Node >= 22.13) is not used.

humanizer.notes: Skill only. Used on delivery (README, delivery.md, docs for people) and in the audit report.md; never on specs, plans or other contracts between agents.
